headline: More rate did not buy more power.
explanation: In the selected window, mean stroke rate rose from 28.4 to 29.8 spm while mean power fell from 165.5 to 157.3 W. Clock-aligned Pegasus review found no reliable visible explanation, so Wake treats recovery timing as a coaching hypothesis rather than a diagnosis.
cue: Protect the recovery sequence before adding rate.
drill: Row a short segment at the current rate with hands away, body over, then slide. Add one stroke per minute only while watts remain at or above the starting average.
successCriterion: Power remains at or above the starting average after the rate increase while the recovery stays controlled.
limitation: Pegasus did not resolve a visible cause from the fixed frontal view. Recovery timing is a Wake coaching hypothesis; pressure, connection, wrist position, and causal mechanics were not measured.
